title: Low-regularity finite element elasticity complexes with hybridizable stresses on tetrahedral Alfeld splits
summary: Finite element elasticity complexes of low regularity are constructed on tetrahedral Alfeld splits. In comparison with existing three-dimensional elasticity complexes on such splits, the complexes constructed here lower both the Sobolev regularity and the polynomial degrees, while ending in a hybridizable $H({\rm div};\mathbb S)$-conforming symmetric stress space with no vertex degrees of freedom.
